shipping_policy_html:
Shipping Policy

Every [BRAND] piece is made to order — for you, from scratch. When you place your order, our workshop begins crafting your piece: casting, setting your IGI-certified lab-grown diamonds, finishing in 18k gold vermeil over sterling silver, 2.5 microns+, and completing quality control.

Production time

  • Crafting: approximately 7 business days from order confirmation.
  • You will receive an email when your piece enters production and another when it ships.
  • Gift with a deadline? Contact us at hello@[BRAND].com and we will do our best to prioritise it.

Delivery — insured express shipping

Once crafted, every order ships via fully insured, tracked express courier. A signature is required on delivery for your protection.

  • United States: 2–3 business days after dispatch (about 9–10 business days from order).
  • United Kingdom: 1–2 business days after dispatch (about 8–9 business days from order).
  • European Union: 2–4 business days after dispatch (about 9–11 business days from order).

Estimates are typical, not guaranteed. Peak periods (holidays) may add 1–3 business days to production.

Duties and taxes (UK and EU orders) — no surprise fees

We ship DDP (Delivered Duty Paid) to the UK and EU wherever available: all applicable import duties and VAT are calculated and collected at checkout, so the price you see at checkout is the final price. Your courier will never ask you to pay customs charges on the doorstep. If a customs charge is ever incorrectly levied on a DDP shipment, contact us with the receipt and we will reimburse you in full.

US orders: applicable state sales tax is calculated at checkout.

Tracking, insurance and delivery issues

  • Every shipment is insured door-to-door at full value.
  • Tracking details are emailed at dispatch and available in your account.
  • If your order arrives damaged, or does not arrive within 5 business days of the courier's estimate, email hello@[BRAND].com within 48 hours and we will replace or refund it — the insurance claim is our job, not yours.

Your IGI certificate

Every [BRAND] piece ships with its own IGI (International Gemological Institute) finished-jewellery report, independently documenting the lab-grown diamonds set in your piece (and the natural diamonds in our halo special piece). Keep it with your purchase record — you will need it for insurance, resizing, warranty service and any return.
refund_policy_html:
Returns & Exchanges Policy

We want you to be certain. You have 30 days from the day of delivery to return or exchange your piece.

How to return

  1. Start your return at [BRAND].com/returns (our returns portal) with your order number and email.
  2. The portal issues a prepaid, tracked, insured return label: US customers return to our US returns point (domestic label — no customs forms); UK and EU customers return to our EU returns hub via our returns consolidator (local-rate label — no customs forms or re-import paperwork for you).
  3. Pack the piece in its original packaging including the IGI report and drop it off. Refunds are issued to the original payment method within 5 business days of the piece passing inspection at our returns point.

Return conditions

  • Items must be unworn, in original condition, with all original packaging and the IGI report included.
  • Return shipping via our portal label is free on your first exchange; for refunds, the cost of the return label is deducted from your refund. Exchanged items ship back to you free.
  • We do not refund original express shipping costs unless the item was faulty.

Free first exchange

Wrong size, wrong length, changed your mind on the stone shape? Your first exchange on any order is completely free — free return label, free re-delivery of the new piece. Because every exchange is made to order, allow about 7 business days of production for the replacement.

Resizing

  • Rings: one complimentary resize within 60 days of delivery (start via the returns portal). We cover the return label and re-delivery.
  • After 60 days, or for additional resizes, we resize at cost (quoted through the portal).
  • Some designs (full pavé bands, engraved bands) can only be resized within a limited range — this is noted on the product page.

Exclusions

The following are final sale and cannot be returned or exchanged (except where faulty):

  • Engraved or otherwise personalised pieces.
  • Bespoke or custom commissions made to your specification.
  • Gift cards.

Your statutory rights are not affected. UK and EU customers retain their statutory 14-day right of withdrawal on eligible items; our 30-day policy is more generous and applies in addition. Under UK/EU consumer law, goods personalised to your specification (engraving, bespoke commissions) are exempt from the statutory withdrawal right, consistent with the exclusions above. Faulty items are always covered regardless of exclusions.

The natural-diamond halo piece

Our one natural-diamond halo special piece is fully returnable within the same 30-day window, provided it is returned with its IGI natural-diamond report. The report is part of the piece's value and identity — a return without the certificate cannot be accepted, so please keep it safe.

2-Year Craftsmanship Warranty

Every [BRAND] piece is covered by a 2-year warranty against manufacturing defects from the date of delivery, including premature wear of the vermeil layer under normal wear, stones loosening in their settings, and clasp or structural failures. If a covered defect appears within 2 years, we will repair or replace the piece free of charge, including insured shipping both ways. Not covered: loss or theft, damage from chemicals or misuse, normal surface wear, or third-party repairs. To make a claim, email hello@[BRAND].com with your order number and photos.
education_page_html:
Everything you actually want to know — including the parts other brands skip.

What is a lab-grown diamond?

A lab-grown diamond is a diamond — carbon atoms in the same crystal structure, grown above ground instead of mined from it. Chemically, optically and physically, lab-grown diamonds are identical to natural diamonds: the same hardness (10 on the Mohs scale), the same brilliance, the same fire. A jeweller's loupe cannot tell them apart; it takes specialised laboratory equipment to distinguish a lab-grown diamond from a natural diamond.

There are two ways to grow one:

  • HPHT (High Pressure, High Temperature) recreates the conditions deep in the Earth where natural diamonds formed — a tiny seed crystal, carbon, and presses exerting enormous pressure at around 1,500°C.
  • CVD (Chemical Vapour Deposition) grows a lab-grown diamond layer by layer inside a vacuum chamber, as carbon atoms from an energised gas settle onto a seed crystal.

Both methods produce the real thing: a lab-grown diamond, not an imitation. (Cubic zirconia and moissanite, by contrast, are different materials entirely — simulants that only look similar.)

How IGI grades our lab-grown diamonds

Every [BRAND] piece is assessed by the International Gemological Institute (IGI), one of the world's largest independent gem laboratories and the leading authority on grading lab-grown diamonds.

IGI grades lab-grown diamonds on the same 4Cs used for natural diamonds:

  • Carat — weight (and therefore size).
  • Colour — how close to colourless, from D (colourless) downward.
  • Clarity — internal characteristics visible under 10x magnification.
  • Cut — the precision of proportions and finish, which determines sparkle.

Because our lab-grown diamonds are set into finished pieces, your certificate is an IGI finished-jewellery report: IGI examines the completed piece and documents the mounted stones' characteristics, the metal, and the piece itself. It ships in the box with every order. Our one natural-diamond halo piece ships with its IGI natural-diamond report.

Independently certified by IGI. Every [BRAND] piece ships with an IGI finished-jewellery report documenting the lab-grown diamonds set in your piece — carat weight, colour, clarity and cut — assessed by an independent laboratory, not by us. Keep your certificate: it supports insurance, resale documentation, warranty service and returns.

Lab-grown vs natural — the honest version

Where they are the same. Composition, hardness, brilliance, durability. A lab-grown diamond will not fade, cloud, or wear out — it is a diamond, permanently.

Where they differ.

  • Origin and rarity. Natural diamonds formed over roughly a billion years underground and are finite. Lab-grown diamonds are grown in weeks and supply keeps expanding. If billion-year rarity is part of the meaning for you, that is a legitimate reason to choose natural — which is why we offer one natural-diamond halo special piece.
  • Price. Lab-grown diamonds cost a fraction of comparable natural diamonds — that is what lets us set genuinely well-cut, well-graded stones at demi-fine prices.
  • Resale value — read this part. Lab-grown diamond prices have fallen substantially as production has scaled, and they may keep falling. A lab-grown diamond is not an investment, and you should not expect meaningful resale value. (Honesty compels us to add: natural diamonds bought at retail also typically resell well below purchase price — jewellery in general is a poor investment vehicle.) Buy a lab-grown diamond for what it is: a beautiful, certified, real stone you will actually wear — at a price that respects the fact you are buying jewellery, not an asset.

We would rather tell you this ourselves than have you read it elsewhere.

Why [BRAND] uses lab-grown diamonds

Our whole premise is fair value: fine-jewellery quality at demi-fine prices, with none of the games.

  • Lab-grown diamonds let us use genuinely well-graded, IGI-certified stones at prices a piece you wear every day should cost.
  • Every piece is made to order in about 7 days. No warehouses of stale stock, no overproduction.
  • We never discount. The price is the fair price on day one and day 365. No fake "was" prices, no countdown timers, no waiting for a sale that is secretly always on.

What is 18k gold vermeil?

Our pieces are crafted in 18k gold vermeil over sterling silver, 2.5 microns+.

Vermeil (pronounced "ver-may") is a legally defined standard, not a marketing word: a sterling silver base coated with real gold of at least 10 karats at a substantial minimum thickness of 2.5 microns. It is precious metal through and through — silver core, thick 18k gold surface.

  • Gold-plated fashion jewellery: typically brass or steel base with a gold flash often under 0.5 microns — it can wear through quickly.
  • [BRAND] vermeil: sterling silver base, 18k gold at 2.5 microns and above — several times thicker, built for years of wear, and backed by our 2-year craftsmanship warranty.
  • Solid gold: gold throughout. Beautiful, and several times the price for the same design. Vermeil is how we keep fine-jewellery quality at demi-fine prices.

Caring for your piece

  • Last on, first off. Put jewellery on after perfume, lotion and hairspray; take it off before bed.
  • Keep it dry-ish. Remove before swimming (chlorine and salt water), showering, workouts and cleaning with household chemicals.
  • Clean gently. Wipe with the soft cloth included in your box. For your lab-grown diamonds, a soft brush with lukewarm water and a drop of mild soap, then pat dry. No ultrasonic cleaners, no abrasive polishing cloths made for solid metals.
  • Store smart. Each piece in its own pouch or compartment — even your own lab-grown diamonds can scratch the gold surface of a neighbouring piece.

Cared for this way, vermeil keeps its colour for years — and it is covered by our 2-year craftsmanship warranty either way.

FAQ

Are lab-grown diamonds real diamonds?

Yes. Lab-grown diamonds have the same chemical composition, crystal structure, hardness and optical properties as natural diamonds. The only difference is origin — grown above ground rather than mined. They are always identified as lab-grown diamonds, which is exactly how we label them, everywhere.

Will a lab-grown diamond pass a diamond tester?

Yes. Standard thermal and electrical testers read lab-grown diamonds as diamond, because they are diamond. Simulants like cubic zirconia fail; lab-grown diamonds do not.

Can anyone tell my stone is lab-grown?

Not by looking, and not with a loupe. Only advanced laboratory instruments can distinguish lab-grown diamonds from natural diamonds. Many certified stones also carry a microscopic girdle inscription identifying them — invisible to the naked eye.

Will my lab-grown diamond fade, cloud, or change over time?

No. A lab-grown diamond is permanent. It will not fade, yellow or lose its sparkle — a quick clean restores day-one brilliance after everyday film from lotions builds up.

What exactly is an IGI finished-jewellery report?

An independent laboratory document from IGI assessing your completed piece: the mounted lab-grown diamonds' carat weight, colour, clarity and cut, plus the metal and setting. One ships with every [BRAND] order. It is your proof of quality for insurance and any future resale or service.

Is vermeil the same as gold-plated?

No. Vermeil is a regulated standard requiring a sterling silver base and a substantial gold layer of at least 2.5 microns. Typical gold plating uses base metals like brass with a far thinner gold layer. Ours is 18k gold vermeil over sterling silver, 2.5 microns+.

Will lab-grown diamonds hold their value?

Honestly: do not count on it. Lab-grown diamond prices have declined as supply has grown. Buy for beauty, certification and fair pricing today — not as an investment. (Retail natural diamonds are also generally poor investments; we just say the quiet part out loud.)

Are lab-grown diamonds eco-friendly?

We do not make that claim. Growing lab-grown diamonds takes significant energy, and the footprint depends on how each grower sources power. Unless we can prove an environmental claim, we will not make it — our promise is fair value and honest labelling, full stop.

Why do you also sell one natural-diamond piece?

Some customers want billion-year-old rarity for a milestone, and we would rather serve that honestly than pretend the preference does not exist. Our single halo special piece features natural diamonds, ships with its IGI natural-diamond report, and is priced with the same fair-value discipline — never discounted.

Can I insure my [BRAND] piece?

Yes — and the IGI report makes it straightforward. Most insurers accept the report as documentation for a jewellery rider or standalone policy. Keep the certificate with your purchase receipt.
